about_the_game:
Hardpoint is a top-down arcade shooter roguelite where you control a platform of four guns, each one able to upgrade into specialized roles along a shared skill tree. Each gun on the platform can be individually customized, and selecting upgrades of the same class will grant additional abilities and bonuses.

Gameplay:

  • The platform will constantly drain energy. More powerful upgrades will increase the rate of energy drain.

  • Guns will automatically fire towards the cursor. Upgrade stats like fire rate and aim speed to defeat the increasing amount of enemies.

  • Upgrade guns along the same tree(s) to specialize their abilities and unlock unique abilities and bonuses. Or, upgrade along different trees and diversify your approach to clear each level.

  • Defeating enemies will drop power cells that can be used to restore energy and purchase upgrades.

  • Survive 15 arenas to win. Each arena is only one minute, but each one is harder than the last.

Featuring

  • 60+ skills. each one granting unique abilities and bonuses

  • 16 classes, each giving stat boosts and modifiers to your platform

  • 15+ Steam achievements
